findings.claim: JPM 於 2026-01-01 提前採用強化版補充槓桿比率（eSLR）最終規則，槓桿緩衝改為 BHC 美國 Method 1 G-SIB 附加費的 50%。
findings.excerpt: the Firm early adopted the enhanced Supplementary Leverage Ratio ("eSLR") final rule. The final rule amended the eSLR requirements for GSIB BHCs and their insured depository institution ("IDI") subsidiaries by revising the previous static leverage buffers at the BHC and IDI levels to 50% of the BHC's U.S. Method 1 GSIB Surcharge

findings.claim: 管理層估計 Basel III endgame 與 G-SIB 再提案使 JPM CET1 需求增加約 4%，而 Fed 對大型銀行的估計為降低約 5%；G-SIB 附加費預計 2028 年前由 4.5% 升至 5.2%，約增 200 億美元資本（其中 130 億來自短期批發融資方法修訂）。仍為提案，未見最終規則。
findings.source: JPMorgan Chase 10-Q (period ended 2026-06-30) 及 Q1 2026 財報電話會議（經 Yahoo Finance 摘要）
findings.excerpt: Management estimates these regulations will require a 4% increase in CET1 capital for JPMorgan Chase, compared to the Federal Reserve's projection of a 5% capital reduction for peers.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 未查得 2026 年針對 JPM 的反壟斷、拆分、DOJ/FTC/歐盟競爭調查；CFPB 亦無結果。GCR 頁面有「JP Morgan reaches settlement in bond market probe」標題但無可見日期，未採用。Basel/G-SIB 細節來自搜尋摘要，未讀原頁。
